simple.meaning: עֹנֶשׁ (ʻônesh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a fine.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across 2 Kings, Proverbs, beginning at 2 Kings 23:33. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֹנֶשׁ (H6066).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
